description: Move, rotate, and resize placed objects with the controllers: point to highlight, GRIP to grab (free objects move/rotate in full 3D; surface-attached objects slide on their surface), GRIP a corner handle to resize. The thumbsticks turn a highlighted object whether or not you are gripping it — right stick ←→ yaws it, left stick pitches and banks a free one; wall art is excluded so it stays flush. Owner-only; a drag commits on release, a stick turn when the stick returns to neutral. Set `mode` to adjust the skybox or a whole void world instead — re-conjuring with a new mode switches the live instance.

mode.desc: what GRIP on empty space adjusts. Use exactly one of: 'object' (default — only placed objects), 'skybox' (grab the floor and drag: away from centre grows the sky, sideways spins it), 'void' (grab the floor and drag to move ALL content in an outdoor/void world together). Objects stay grabbable in every mode. Skybox scale and void mode need a void/outdoor world; skybox yaw works anywhere.

reelSpeed.desc: metres/sec the thumbstick reels a grabbed object in/out

rotateSpeed.desc: degrees/sec a held model turns at full stick deflection
